verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer-token auth that can access, create and manipulate content, plus an official MCP server for custom clients. Scripts and workflows can therefore create notes from outside, but only through a remote API, not by driving the app itself. Nothing shows a URI scheme, deep links that open specific notes in the app, or a local endpoint. Missing for 10: URI scheme/deep-link support for creating or opening notes in the app, a local endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), and hands-on corroboration of scripted use.
